description: Demo QA question set for the two demo corpora live on one :local target (owner decision 2026-11-10, twenty-second set): 'rsoxs' (the most complete RSoXS KG, storage/kg/matkg_rsoxs_v4.json, 22012 things) and 'qwen3_235b_580papers' (the 580-paper OPV KG, 15815 things). Each answerable question names its expected corpus and passes when an expected node of THAT corpus is among the returned nodes (about 2000 node ids exist in both KGs, so the corpus matters: the chat's graph ids are the corpus names). answerable=false questions must still get a normal answer that opens with the italic sentence 'The knowledge graph has no information on this question.' (owner decision 2026-11-10); the three were chosen because the off-domain gate fires for them over the 38k-node union (most general-knowledge questions share some word with a node and defeat the gate, gap G2). expected_node_ids are curated with scripts/demo/qa_expected_nodes.py --check (real lexical retriever, both KGs loaded as the chat loads them): each is retrieved from the question's corpus within the first 40 hits under every PYTHONHASHSEED tried (hit order is not stable, membership is).
